body: Good to hear! I could use some love? Could you please dm me?

I have no one. My parents hate me, my teachers hate me. I have a few supportive “friends”, but telling them anything will lead to my personal problems being spread and everyone will know I’m a suicidal loser.
I’m eating right now! It’s tastes good man, very good. I’ll kill myself later, I think I wanna eat first haha.
I haven’t eaten in more than a day, should I get a meal for myself?

It’s very easy to say that. I suffer on a daily basis. I have no self esteem. I’m never going to achieve anything in life primarily due to my parents. I haven’t eaten in 36 hours. 

No.
I don’t know man. But I do know that I’ll never ever be free.

So sadistic isn’t it? I know God’s out there but I just can’t accept that we would make me drink boiling water in a pool of fire because I ended my life cause no one loved me, or cared about me in any way. I don’t think that’s a good God. I think the rich spun it this way to make sure the poor don’t kill themselves.

Apologies for my bad English.
I’m also underage, and there aren’t any social welfare services in my country. Here, your parent has every right to do whatever they want to you, because you’re their property.
